about: Published strategies. Each one is a target allocation on one chain with a change log. Followers hold the tokens in their own wallet; when a manager changes the weights, followers adopt the new version with one tap and confirm the trades themselves. To publish here, open a pull request adding an entry (see promo/README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository).
